title: Track & hold budget
description: A track-and-hold front end sized from its two hard limits: the $kT/C$ sampled-noise floor sets the sampling capacitor, and the sampling switch sets the tracking bandwidth. The cap comes first ($C_s \geq kT/v_n^2$), then one NMOS switch is bound width-first at a small test $V_{DS}$ so its on-resistance follows from the reported current; the switch is driven at the supply, so retune the $g_m/I_D$ knob until the reported $V_{GS}$ equals VDD (the consistency guardrail checks it). Tracking settles as $\tau = R_{on}*C_s$ and must resolve to the sampling accuracy within the track phase. Charge injection is an estimate from the channel charge dumped onto $C_s$. Assumes a simple NMOS switch to ground; a bootstrapped or complementary switch and the real clock edge are sim-owned.

params.name: vn_kTC_target
params.note: sampled thermal-noise RMS budget; sets the kT/C floor on C_s

params.name: C_s
params.note: sampling capacitor; larger lowers kT/C noise but slows tracking

params.name: vds_test
params.note: small drain bias for the on-resistance estimate (triode); signed to the table axis

params.name: gm_id_on
params.note: switch inversion knob; retune until reported vgs equals VDD (switch on hard)

params.name: W_sw
params.note: switch width; wider lowers Ron but injects more charge

params.name: L
params.note: minimum channel length for a fast switch

params.name: eps_settle
params.note: tracking settling accuracy; sets the number of time constants

params.name: T_track
params.note: time available in the track phase

rows.name: C_s_min
rows.note: kT/C floor: the sampling cap that meets the sampled-noise budget

rows.name: Ron
rows.note: on-resistance from the small-vds current; triode estimate, sim confirms the real bias

rows.name: N_tau_req
rows.note: time constants needed to settle to eps_settle

rows.name: dV_qinj
rows.note: charge-injection step: half the channel inversion charge (cgg*Vov, with Vov ~ V*) onto C_s; estimate, sim owns the clock edge

rules.note: gm/ID cannot exceed the weak-inversion ceiling of the data
sampling cap meets the kT/C sampled-noise floor
the RC of switch and cap must settle to eps_settle within the track phase
the switch is gate-driven at VDD; retune gm_id_on until the reported vgs matches
channel-charge dump onto C_s; estimate-grade, sim signs off with the real clock
